name: postcode-context
description: Great Britain Postcode & Outcode Intelligence MCP Server covering England, Scotland, and Wales. Provides area-level context including Census demographics, statutory IMD deprivation deciles, residential property transaction metrics, EPC energy efficiency ratings, Ofcom broadband throughput, and rail proximity. Excludes Northern Ireland (BT) and Crown Dependencies (JE, GY, IM).

coverage.exclusions: Covers Great Britain (England, Scotland, and Wales). Northern Ireland (BT) postcodes and Crown Dependencies (JE, GY, IM) are not covered.

resources.name: data_dictionary
resources.title: Postcode Context Data Dictionary
resources.description: Complete field definitions, mathematical formulas, statistical scales, and data sources for all 113 metrics in the database.

resources.name: data_attribution
resources.title: Postcode Context Statutory Attribution & Provenance Register
resources.description: Official statutory attribution statements, Crown copyright notices, and Open Government Licence v3.0 metadata across all 19 data providers.

tools.name: lookup_postcode
tools.title: Lookup Great Britain Postcode Intelligence Profile
tools.description: Use when you need demographic, property, EPC energy efficiency, broadband, or socio-economic context for a Great Britain unit postcode (England, Scotland, Wales). Returns full profile by default; use view="brief" (~80 tokens) for low-token, concise briefings when managing context budget. Do not use for non-GB postcodes (e.g. Northern Ireland BT) or when comparing multiple postcodes simultaneously (use compare_postcodes instead).

postcode.description: Great Britain unit postcode to analyze (e.g. SW1A 1AA, BB7 3BB, EH1 1YZ, CF10 1EP). Space-optional, case-insensitive.

view.description: View slice to return: "full" (complete 113-metric profile, default), "brief" (or "summary"/"ai", ~80 tokens summary with AI affluence tier & persona, recommended for token efficiency), "property" (prices & EPC), "demographics" (Census & IMD deciles), "education" (or "schools"), "healthcare" (or "health"), "transit" (or "transport"), or "services" (or "infrastructure").

exclude.description: Optional domain(s) to exclude: "schools", "healthcare", "transit" as a comma-separated string (e.g. "schools, healthcare") or an array of strings (e.g. ["schools", "healthcare"]). Note: exclude only applies when view="full"; ignored if a specific view slice is selected.

tools.name: compare_postcodes
tools.title: Compare Great Britain Postcodes Side-by-Side
tools.description: Use when you need to directly contrast 2 to 5 Great Britain postcodes across affluence, safety, housing cost per m², broadband, and family suitability. Returns full profiles by default; use view="brief" (~80 tokens per postcode) to keep context compact alongside the comparison ranking. Do not use for single postcode inspection (use lookup_postcode) or bulk batches of >5 postcodes (use enrich_postcodes).

postcodes.description: Array of 2 to 5 Great Britain postcodes to compare.

view.description: View slice for returned postcode profiles: "full" (complete profile per postcode, default), "brief" (or "summary"/"ai", ~80 tokens per postcode, recommended to minimize context usage alongside comparison ranking), "property", "demographics", "education", "healthcare", "transit", or "services".

tools.name: enrich_postcodes
tools.title: Enrich Bulk Great Britain Postcodes Cohort
tools.description: Bulk demographic, economic, and spatial lookup for 1 to 50 Great Britain postcodes. Returns brief profile by default (~80 tokens per postcode) to prevent context blow-up; use view="full" when all 113 metrics are needed. Cost-effective for 6 to 50 postcodes ($0.050 flat fee). For 1 postcode use lookup_postcode ($0.005); for 2 to 5 postcodes use compare_postcodes ($0.010). Do not use when detailed side-by-side comparative rankings are required (use compare_postcodes).

postcodes.description: Array of 1 to 50 Great Britain postcodes to enrich. Cost-effective for 6 to 50 postcodes ($0.050 flat fee). For 1 postcode use lookup_postcode ($0.005); for 2 to 5 postcodes use compare_postcodes ($0.010).

view.description: View slice for each postcode in the batch results: "brief" (or "summary"/"ai", ~80 tokens per postcode, default for batch calls to prevent context blow-up), "full" (complete 113-metric dataset per postcode, explicitly requested when all metrics needed), "property", "demographics", "education", "healthcare", "transit", or "services".

tools.name: summarise_outcode
tools.title: Summarise Outward Postal District
tools.description: Use when you only have an outward code / district (e.g. SW1A, BB7, EH1, CF10) and need high-level district demographic and property statistics (~150 tokens). Do not use when an exact full unit postcode is available (use lookup_postcode).

outcode.description: Valid outward postal district code (e.g. SW1A, BB7, EH1, CF10).

view.description: Optional view slice to return: "full" (complete district summary, default), "brief" (or "summary"/"ai", ~80 tokens context summary), "property", "demographics", "education", "healthcare", "transit", or "services".

exclude.description: Optional domain(s) to exclude: "schools", "healthcare", "transit" as a comma-separated string (e.g. "schools, healthcare") or an array of strings (e.g. ["schools", "healthcare"]). Note: exclude only applies when view="full"; ignored if a specific view slice is selected.

tools.name: get_data_attribution
tools.title: Get Data Provenance & Statutory Attribution Register
tools.description: Free reference tool: Retrieve official statutory attribution statements, Crown copyright notices, and Open Government Licence v3.0 metadata across all data providers.

tools.name: get_data_dictionary
tools.title: Get Data Dictionary & Field Methodology
tools.description: Free reference tool: Retrieve exact field specifications, mathematical calculation formulas, statistical scales, and data sources for any metric across Great Britain in the Postcode Context database.

domain.description: Statistical domain category filter. Use "summary_for_ai" (default) for a compact token-efficient overview (~8 fields) for AI agents, or "all" for the complete 113-metric specification.

field.description: Optional specific field name to inspect.
